commit.message:
LU-20847 lnetctl: unknown peer msg is dropped

"lnetctl peer XXX" of an unknown peer was dropping kernel
error report.

yaml_lnet_peer_display() now returns 0 on a netlink reader error, so
yaml_lnet_peer() reports the kernel extack message.

Test-parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Cyril Bordage <cbordage@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: I0da574282f9e77c40b11ac33c82b8c4d71f5a8dd
Fixes: 9d78f39798 ("LU-18083 utils: handle more than one peer NI per peer")
